description: Reads only the private receipt timeline for the supplied job or thread ID. Returns receipt links, has_more, and a cursor for the next page. Use since to filter by an inclusive RFC3339 timestamp. Optional AI client labels are self-reported, not verified.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

ai_filter.description: Optional self-reported AI client label to match, or 'unreported'.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor returned by the previous continuity_get_recent result.

limit.description: Maximum receipt-backed events to return. Defaults to 20.

since.description: Optional inclusive RFC3339 timestamp lower bound. Keep it unchanged while following a cursor.

thread_id.description: Optional named thread ID. If omitted, reads the job and its named threads.

name: continuity_get_recent

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.

title: Continuity: get recent
